extension.summary: Keeps the Streamlet CZ playlist for IPTV Simple up to date with working EPG ids.
Udržiava playlist Streamlet CZ pre IPTV Simple s opravenými ID pre EPG.
extension.description: Downloads the Streamlet CZ playlist every few hours, strips the suffix (@SD, @Czechia...) from tvg-id so channels match the open-epg.com guide, and stores it locally. Creates an IPTV Simple instance reading it, only when no instance already reads that file or the Streamlet URL directly. Channels that O2 TV already provides (it has the archive) are left out. Existing instances are never changed, except this addon's own instance, which is switched to the locally stored guide. The guide (XMLTV) is downloaded by the addon itself once in a while, because open-epg.com limits downloads to 20 a day per IP.

Každých pár hodín stiahne playlist Streamlet CZ, odstrihne z tvg-id príponu (@SD, @Czechia...), aby sa kanály zhodovali s programom z open-epg.com, a uloží ho lokálne. Vytvorí inštanciu IPTV Simple, ktorá ho číta, len keď ten súbor ani URL streamletu priamo ešte nič nečíta. Kanály, ktoré už má O2 TV (s archívom), vynechá. Existujúce inštancie sa nikdy nemenia, okrem vlastnej inštancie doplnku, ktorá sa prepne na lokálne uložené EPG. EPG (XMLTV) si doplnok sťahuje sám raz za pár hodín, lebo open-epg.com dovolí len 20 stiahnutí denne na IP.
